query.commandtext: SELECT * FROM ?? WHERE 1 = 1 AND WAFER_SEQ IN (??)

SELECT B.LOT_ID || '-' || B.WAFER_ID || '-' || DIEID || '-' || X || '-' || Y "LOT-WAFER-DIE-X-Y", ?? FROM ( SELECT WAFER_SEQ, DIEID, X, Y, ?? FROM T_PCM_?? WHERE WAFER_SEQ IN (??) ) A, T_TPS_WAFER_SUM B WHERE A.WAFER_SEQ = B.WAFER_SEQ

-- (agv, min, max, ...), zone을 선택하지 않았을때(total yield) SELECT B.LOT_ID, B.WAFER_ID, B.YIELD, ?? FROM ( SELECT L.LOT_ID,W.WAFER_ID,P.WAFER_SEQ, ?? FROM T_PCM_?? P,T_TPS_LOT L,T_TPS_WAFER W WHERE L.LOT_ID IN (??) AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND W.WAFER_SEQ = P.WAFER_SEQ GROUP BY L.LOT_ID,W.WAFER_ID,P.WAFER_SEQ ) A, ( SELECT LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, YIELD FROM T_TPS_WAFER_SUM WHERE LOT_ID IN (??) ) B WHERE A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID AND A.WAFER_ID = B.WAFER_ID ORDER BY B.LOT_ID, B.WAFER_ID

query.description: wafer 별 pcm test data를 가져온다
query.commandtext: SELECT LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, A.WAFER_SEQ, DIEID, ?? FROM T_PCM_?? A, ( SELECT LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, WAFER_SEQ FROM T_TPS_WAFER A, T_TPS_LOT B WHERE WAFER_SEQ IN (??) AND A.LOT_SEQ=B.LOT_SEQ ) B WHERE A.WAFER_SEQ=B.WAFER_SEQ ORDER BY DIEID

query.description: wafer 별 pcm test data를 가져온다
query.commandtext: SELECT LOT_ID, WAFER_ID,A.WAFER_SEQ, DIEID, ?? FROM T_PCM_?? A, ( SELECT LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, WAFER_SEQ FROM T_TPS_WAFER A, T_TPS_LOT B WHERE WAFER_SEQ IN (??) AND A.LOT_SEQ=B.LOT_SEQ ) B WHERE A.WAFER_SEQ=B.WAFER_SEQ ORDER BY LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, DIEID

query.description: PCM Test를 한 die id 갯수를 가져온다
query.commandtext: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DIEID) CNT FROM T_PCM_?? WHERE WAFER_SEQ IN (??)

SELECT LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, A.WAFER_SEQ, DIEID, DAY, ?? FROM T_PCM_?? A, ( SELECT LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, WAFER_SEQ, to_char(A.END_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd') DAY FROM T_TPS_WAFER A, T_TPS_LOT B WHERE WAFER_SEQ IN (??) AND A.LOT_SEQ=B.LOT_SEQ ) B WHERE A.WAFER_SEQ=B.WAFER_SEQ ORDER BY DAY

-- pcm yield trend by wafer SELECT LOT_ID || '-' || WAFER_ID "LOT-WAFER", YIELD FROM T_TPS_WAFER_SUM WHERE LOT_ID || WAFER_ID IN ( SELECT B.LOT_ID || A.WAFER_ID FROM T_TPS_WAFER A, T_TPS_LOT B WHERE WAFER_SEQ IN (??) AND A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ ) ORDER BY LOT_ID, WAFER_ID

-- pcm yield trend by lot SELECT LOT_ID, ROUND(AVG(YIELD), 2) YIELD FROM T_TPS_WAFER_SUM WHERE LOT_ID || WAFER_ID IN ( SELECT B.LOT_ID || A.WAFER_ID FROM T_TPS_WAFER A, T_TPS_LOT B WHERE WAFER_SEQ IN (??) AND A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ ) GROUP BY LOT_ID ORDER BY LOT_ID

SELECT TO_CHAR(END_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd') "DATE", ROUND(AVG(YIELD), 2) YIELD FROM T_TPS_WAFER_SUM WHERE LOT_ID || WAFER_ID IN ( SELECT B.LOT_ID || A.WAFER_ID FROM T_TPS_WAFER A, T_TPS_LOT B WHERE WAFER_SEQ IN (??) AND A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ ) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(END_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ORDER BY "DATE"
SELECT COUNT(ZONEID) CNT FROM T_TPS_ZONE WHERE PRODUCT=:product AND USER_NAME=:userId AND ZONEID=:zone

SELECT COUNT(DIEID) CNT FROM TD_?? A, ( SELECT X, Y FROM T_TPS_ZONE WHERE PRODUCT=:product AND USER_NAME=:user AND ZONEID=:zoneId ) B WHERE WAFER_SEQ=:waferSeq AND A.X = B.X AND A.Y = B.Y AND BIN IN (1)

SELECT DISTINCT 'BIN' || BIN || ' : ' || BIN_NAME BIN FROM T_TPS_BINDESC WHERE PROGRAM IN (SELECT DISTINCT PROGRAM FROM T_TPS_LOT_SUM WHERE LOT_ID IN (??)) AND PRODUCT IN (SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT FROM T_TPS_LOT_SUM WHERE LOT_ID IN (??)) ORDER BY BIN

query.description: Zone 선택한 zone에 해당하는 yield를 가져온다.
query.commandtext: -- pcm die(1, 2, 3, 4, 5,...) 과 test bin을 선택했을때 SELECT B.LOT_ID, B.WAFER_ID, B.YIELD, ?? FROM ( SELECT L.LOT_ID,W.WAFER_ID,P.WAFER_SEQ, ?? FROM T_PCM_?? P,T_TPS_LOT L,T_TPS_WAFER W WHERE L.LOT_ID IN (??) AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND W.WAFER_SEQ = P.WAFER_SEQ AND P.DIEID=:zone ) A, ( SELECT LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, B.YIELD FROM T_TPS_WAFER_SUM A, ( SELECT WAFER_SEQ, ROUND(COUNT(DIEID) / ?? * 100, 2) YIELD FROM TD_?? A, ( SELECT X, Y FROM T_TPS_ZONE WHERE PRODUCT=:product AND USER_NAME=:userId AND ZONEID=:zone ) B WHERE WAFER_SEQ IN ( SELECT WAFER_SEQ FROM T_TPS_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ IN ( SELECT LOT_SEQ FROM T_TPS_LOT WHERE LOT_ID IN (??) AND TESTAREA IN ('PT1', 'PT2', 'MULTIPROBE') ) ) AND A.X = B.X AND A.Y = B.Y AND BIN IN (??) GROUP BY WAFER_SEQ ORDER BY WAFER_SEQ ) B WHERE A.WAFER_SEQ=B.WAFER_SEQ ORDER BY LOT_ID, WAFER_ID ) B WHERE A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID AND A.WAFER_ID = B.WAFER_ID ORDER BY B.LOT_ID, B.WAFER_ID
SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT, PROGRAM FROM T_TPS_WAFER_SUM WHERE LOT_ID IN (??) AND TESTAREA IN ('PT1', 'PT2', 'MULTIPROBE')
SELECT SITE_CNT FROM T_TPS_PROGRAM WHERE PROGRAM = :program AND TESTAREA='PARAMETRIC'
